pages.text: $(li)$(l)Excalibur$() deals void damage, which bypasses all armor and damage mitigation—ideal for bosses like the Diabetic Meatball Fiend that ignore conventional damage.$(li)$(l)Kikoku$() is the strongest weapon in Chapter 5;
$(l)Last Stand$() is also highly effective.$(li)Unbreakable armor is a good idea; the doped electrode super-enchant Unbreaking is fine in a pinch.
$(li)Use the $(l)Tax Collector bee gun$() on Shell Bosses (e.g., Halite Warrior) to obtain parts directly, avoiding repeated kills; note it does not work on Candor.
$(li)The $(l)Dread Servant$() boss in Pixonia starts with 15,000 HP lost on spawn, leaving only 20 HP remaining—making it trivial to kill once spawned.
$(li)For better bow damage, get better enchants on the bow and your armor, and work on your Astral Sorcery perks.
